prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"Build a finite-state machine that searches for the sequence 1101 in an input bit stream.","S02":"When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.","S03":"Reset is active high synchronous."}
Contract JSON:

matched","update_time":"posedge","update_during_reset":true},{"name":"S1","meaning":"matched '1'","update_time":"posedge","update_during_reset":true},{"name":"S2","meaning":"matched == 0 and state == S4","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":0,"data":1},{"reset":0,"data":1},{"reset":0,"data":0},{"reset":0,"data":1}],"expected":[{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":0}]}},{"id":"R3","outputs":["start_shifting"],"condition":"reset 1101","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":0,"data":1},{"reset":0,"data":1},{"reset":0,"data":0},{"reset":0,"data":1}],"expected":[{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":0}]}},{"id":"R4","outputs":["start_shifting"],"condition":"reset 1101","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":0,"data":1},{"reset":0,"data":0},{"reset":0,"data":1}],"expected":[{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":0}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"sync","name":"reset","active":"high","values":{"start_shifting":0},"first_released_cycle":"first
